race.comment: MONSIEUR CLAUDE (4) was sent out a $2.50 favourite on debut here and ran on strongly from a long way back, doing a bit wrong in the run. Does draw very wide again here which is the niggle but he should improve and can atone.  TROUBLE'N PARADISE (8) just missed in a bunched finish first up at Sale and should come on from that. Each way. CLUX STAR (9) is going along well with three placings from six starts this time in. Rates a danger. AMARILLO SKY (1) has been in the market at his recent starts but yet to break through, the latest running fourth at Tatura when fresh. Looks one for the minors. BRILLIANT BULL ANT (3) knuckled down strongly when finished half a length from the winner at Ballarat. One for consideration.
